name: What's the difference between a pressure-balancing and a thermostatic shower cartridge?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a pressure-balancing and a thermostatic shower cartridge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressure-balancing and thermostatic shower cartridges both regulate water temperature, but they do so differently. A pressure-balancing cartridge reacts to changes in water pressure, adjusting the mix of hot and cold water to maintain a consistent temperature, preventing scalding or sudden cold shocks when another fixture is used. A thermostatic cartridge, however, maintains a precise temperature by blending hot and cold water to a set degree, even if pressure fluctuates. Thermostatic cartridges often offer more precise control and separate volume and temperature controls, which can be a key decision factor depending on your preference for comfort and control in the shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pressure-balancing cartridges react to pressure changes to maintain temperature, while thermostatic cartridges maintain a precise set temperature regardless of pressure fluctuations.
